dia_chi_raw: Tầng 15, Epic Tower, ngõ 19 Duy Tân, Phường Cầu Giấy
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Architecture & Planning: Lead audio software design and planning for automotive cockpits to ensure reliable, high-performance capture, processing, and playback.
Module & Pipeline Design: Define software layering, interfaces, routing, audio effects (EQ/DSP/AEC), multi-channel management, and source priority.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with HW, algorithm, and system teams to adapt, optimize, and bring audio systems to mass production on cockpit SoCs.
Issue Resolution: Fix complex cockpit audio bugs, including latency, jitter, clock sync, and multi-core communication.
Standards & Process: Set technical specs and coding standards to deliver modular, reusable audio software
yeu_cau:
Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in CS, EE, Communications, Acoustics, or related fields (flexible for top candidates).
Experience: 3+ years in embedded or Linux/Android dev, with 1–2+ years in audio (cockpit, mobile, smart speakers, headphones; auto experience optional).
Audio Tech Stack: Familiarity with audio frameworks (Android Audio HAL/Audio Flinger, tiny-alsa, Linux ALSA/Pulse Audio) and audio pipeline basics. DSP experience is a plus.
Coding: Strong C/C++ skills with a modular design mindset. (Architecture experience preferred but can be learned on the job).
Plusses:
Cockpit SoCs (Qualcomm/Renesas/NXP) or heterogeneous multi-core platforms.
In-vehicle networks (CAN / Ethernet / A2B) and audio transport protocols.
English proficiency (working level required); Chinese is a plus.
